title: Protocol (DeFi aggregate)
description: One DeFi protocol's aggregate state. Provider is DefiLlama, whose own identifier is a slug - and whose `/protocols` body is ~8.9 MB of 8386 rows, which is why the sidecar trims to a top-N and MUST label the result as derived and truncated (upstream sends UNSORTED; the sort is ours). TVL nullability is NOT a mistake to fix: 'null happens upstream (1238 of 8386 rows) -> UI shows em-dash' - a protocol whose TVL the provider omits must render as an em-dash, never as 0, because 0 would read as 'this protocol holds nothing'.

protocol_id.description: The DefiLlama slug today. Once a mapping table exists this becomes an opaque canonical id and the slug moves to provider_ids.

category.description: Provider taxonomy, opaque string - no canonical category set exists.

tvl_usd.description: Null = the provider omitted it (real: ~15% of rows). NEVER 0.

chains.description: Chain NAMES as the provider spells them; not chain_ids - the provider's vocabulary is upstream of our registry.
